manifest.changeSummary: 27회차 검증 누적본: 신규 필기 13개·실기 1개, 누적 일반 882개·기존 시드14개. 실제 전달 검증된26회차를 기준으로 하며23회차의 원 판정·예약은 보존하되 발행 차단된 문항을 포함하지 않는다. 새 문항의 전체 해설에는 실제 풀이 규칙과 적용 결과를 담았다. Git/Pages 공개 여부는 별도 확인한다.

limitations: This separately verified cumulative payload does not rewrite original closed decisions, immutable banks, delivery checkpoints, ZIPs, or their original publication counters.

Original isolated round-018 and the earlier 2026-10-07 retry outcomes remain unknown. A separately authorized later identical blob attempt succeeded; this event verifies current content publication, not settlement of those earlier calls.

The payload commit and its Pages/live evidence precede this supporting record. A later support commit needs its own deployment verification.
